meta.description: Largest burned area on record in Portugal. Started by dry lightning above Piódão (Arganil) and spread into Seia, Covilhã, Fundão and Castelo Branco.

elevation_source.licence: Open data; attribution to Mapzen and sources (SRTM, EU-DEM, …)
elevation_source.name: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen / AWS Open Data), zoom 11, bilinear to 200 m

meta.fleet_rule: Drones = 2 at detection + 1 per 4 km of active front + 1 per 150 ha/h of growth (max 24). Two multirotor scouts (15 m/s, 60 min), the rest fixed-wing VTOL perimeter drones (18 m/s, 90 min), all demonstration values. Bases sit 3 km outside the modelled fire in the cleanest air; routes avoid cells with ≥30% burn probability within the hour and slow down in smoke; task points spread along the flanks and rear, never the head.

ignition.basis: Piódão village coordinates; reports place the start on the slope above the village around 05:00 local (approximate).

meta.method: Forecast from the ignition point to the first observed perimeter, then re-initialised from each observed perimeter (GWIS) and scored against the next one with the Sørensen–Dice coefficient (1 = perfect overlap).
meta.model: firecast-v1 (Rothermel–Albini surface + Van Wagner/Rothermel 1991 crown spread, Anderson ellipse, MTT ensemble; Briggs/Pasquill Gaussian plume)
meta.name: Arganil / Piódão wildfire, 13–24 August 2025
